title: Claude Code skill scripts, animates and sound-mixes complete videos without After Effects
summary: Miftahul Islam Efaz built a skill that has Claude Code script, animate and sound-mix videos; the author says the skill's own 56-second 1080p launch ad was made with it.
agent_role: The agent writes scripts and storyboards, animates scenes in code, edits footage, renders previews and mixes sound. The human supplies references, generates the voiceover MP3 and approves each gate.
outcome: Author reports the skill's own 56-second 1080p launch ad, with voiceover, 2D/3D animation and sound mix, was produced with it.
what_they_did: Developer Miftahul Islam Efaz built Motion Video Director, a skill that has Claude Code (or Codex or Cursor) work like a small video team. The agent collects a brief, writes a voiceover script, times a storyboard to the words, animates scenes in code with tools like Three.js, edits footage, renders preview contact sheets and mixes sound to -14 LUFS with ffmpeg. The user generates the voiceover MP3 in ElevenLabs and approves the script, plan and preview.
how_it_went: The author says the skill's own 56-second 1080p launch ad was made with it, including voiceover, 2D/3D animation and a full sound mix. The README also links several example videos posted on Instagram.
worth_knowing: The core helpers need Python 3.10+, FFmpeg and ffprobe, and browser rendering also needs Node.js 18+ and Playwright/Chromium. The skill is told to ask before installing or downloading anything.
prompt: Using the Motion Video Director skill, make a [length]-second [9:16 / 16:9 / 1:1] video about [product or topic] for [audience]. References are attached: [reference links or files]. Start with the brief, then write a voiceover script I can paste into ElevenLabs. I will generate the MP3 and send it back. After that, storyboard every shot to the voiceover timing and show me the plan. Wait for my approval before you build. Render preview contact sheets, fix any problems, and get my approval again before the final render with sound design and loudness normalization. Log your progress in PROGRESS.md.

curation.rationale: The skill shows a concrete agent video-production workflow with approval gates, and its author's demos include a 56-second launch ad. Evidence is self-produced examples with a promotional tone, and it overlaps with earlier Claude Code video skills.
